text_en: Among non-trading products, the following shall be classified into the trading account. (i) Products held for the purpose of market-making business. (ii) Equity investments in funds (limited to those falling under either of the following requirements): (a) The Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. can perform look-through (meaning understanding information relating to each individual exposure in the same manner as directly held assets; the same applies in Chapter 6) with respect to the constituent securities of such fund and has obtained sufficient information verified by an independent third party. (b) The Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. obtains the market value of such fund on a daily basis and has obtained information relating to the fund's management standards and market risk equivalent amounts. (iii) Listed stocks. (iv) Repo-type transactions relating to trading business. (v) Options.

(i) Products held for the purpose of market-making business.

(iv) Repo-type transactions relating to trading business.
